label: Upstream 0.91.2, and Fast is now a model you pick

sections.title: Fast, right in the model picker
items: Fast is now a model you choose, the same way you pick any other. Sign in with ChatGPT and you'll find `GPT-6 Astra Fast`, `GPT-6.1 Sol Fast` and `GPT-6 Luna Fast`, or sign in with Claude for `Claude Opus 5.5 Fast`. Same models, answering quicker. Fast GPT models use up your plan's limits faster, and `Claude Opus 5.5 Fast` runs on Claude usage credits instead of your plan. If those credits are off, you'll get a clear note on how to turn them on rather than a confusing limit error.

The old `Fast on · 2.5× credits` switch under `More` is gone, because `GPT-6 Astra Fast` does exactly the same thing and now sits with the rest of your models. Chats where you'd switched it on reopen on `GPT-6 Astra Fast` by themselves, keeping the `Stable` or `Experimental` context you picked. Pick `GPT-6 Astra` again any time to go back to normal speed.

sections.title: Upstream 0.91.2
items: Zoom in or out with `Ctrl +` and `Ctrl -` all you like. Your chat now stays right where it belongs, with the newest message sitting neatly above the message box instead of sliding underneath it. Resizing the window or a split pane keeps your chat on its newest line too.

`esc` closes the panel under your message box, wherever you clicked. Your agent keeps right on working while you do it, and one more `esc` stops it whenever you want. With panes side by side, it closes only the panel in the pane you're working in, so the others stay just as you left them. `Usage` and `Model` now get the same tidy header and close button as everything else.
`Goal settings` now uses the whole panel. No more odd empty strip down the side, and the context box hugs what you've added instead of sitting there as a big empty slab.
